copy.label: Appliance repairs
headline: Fixed, not
replaced.
copy.sub: Washing machines, ovens, tumble dryers and cooker hoods repaired across Reading and nearby, and new washing machines fitted. You know the price before Dan starts.
copy.alt: A washing machine and tumble dryer in a bright utility room
copy.about_alt: Close-up of a washing machine's controls
copy.lede: Prime Appliance Repairs is Dan, a local appliance engineer just outside Reading. He finds out what's actually wrong, explains it in plain English and tells you the price up front, so there are no surprises. Plenty of customers have saved the cost of a new machine.
copy.services_intro: Repairs and installs for the machines you use every day.

services.title: Washing machine repairs
services.blurb: Not spinning, not draining, leaking or stuck mid-cycle. Found and fixed.
services.intro: Most faults are found on the first visit, and Dan tells you what went wrong before he fixes it.

services.title: Washing machine installation
services.blurb: New machines fitted, plumbed in and tested, with the old one checked first in case it's worth saving.
services.intro: Fitted properly so it doesn't leak or walk across the floor.

services.title: Oven and cooker repairs
services.blurb: Fan ovens not heating, elements, thermostats and doors.
services.intro: Found fast and explained, with the price agreed before any work.

services.title: Tumble dryer repairs
services.blurb: Not heating, not turning or stopping early. Back up and running.
services.intro: Dryers fixed in your home where possible.

services.title: Cooker hood repairs
services.blurb: Fans, lights and switches that have given up.
services.intro: Often a simple fix that saves buying a new hood.

services.title: Fault finding and advice
services.blurb: Not sure what's wrong? Dan will diagnose it and tell you straight if it's worth fixing.
services.intro: An honest answer on whether to repair or replace.
includes: Straight answer on repair or replace

faqs: Is it worth repairing, or should I buy new?
Dan will tell you straight. A repair often costs far less than a new machine, and if it isn't worth fixing he'll say so.
Will I know the price first?
Yes. You'll know what it costs before any work starts.
Do you fit new washing machines?
Yes. Dan installs washing machines, and can check the old one first in case it's worth saving.
Reading and the villages around it, including Tilehurst, Purley on Thames and Pangbourne. Call to check if you're further out.
copy.quote_intro: Tell Dan what's playing up and he'll get back to you with a price.
